meta.note: Keys are raw Chinese string literal content as written in the source (escapes preserved). Values are the English replacement. Entries may be plain strings, or { "en": "...", "exactOnly": true } for short/generic labels that must only replace a whole literal. Template values may keep ${...} interpolation syntax; exact-match values are inserted verbatim, segment values are inserted escaped-safe. See tools/i18n/README.md.
